comparison.objective: Separate already formed ceramic media from metal parts vs grind peppercorns to a specified particle-size distribution.
comparison.physical_skill: Mobilize intact elongated bodies through a screen while retaining larger workpieces vs apply pestle pressure/impact to fracture material in a mortar.
comparison.success_condition: ≥98% intact media recovered with no spill and all washers retained vs required mass fractions passing 1.4 mm and 0.6 mm test sieves, limited loss, and safe pestle set-down.
comparison.reason: Although both mention sieves and mass fractions, the record uses sieves only to measure comminution; it does not test operating a separating screen.
